name: scenario_Firmware_MoonBase_opens_the_devices_access_point
description: MoonBase with no network to join opens the device's own access point, under its name, with the same sign-in screen as the app, so a phone on the app's access point stays on through the restart. The device forgets its network and opens its access point; this computer joins it, restarts the device in MoonBase, finds the sign-in redirect, boots the app and gives the device its network back. It takes the computer off its network for a few minutes, so it runs only when named, with --network naming the moondeck.json network the device is on.

steps.name: on-its-network
steps.description: The device starts on WiFi, on the network the run names.

steps.name: forget-the-network
steps.description: With nothing to join, the app opens its access point, and so will MoonBase.

steps.name: restart-in-moonbase
steps.description: The Firmware card's Restart in MoonBase, pressed from a phone on the access point.

steps.name: still-on-the-same-network
steps.description: MoonBase opens the access point under the device's name, so the computer rejoins the network it was on rather than a stranger.

steps.name: a-phone-sees-the-sign-in-screen
steps.description: MoonBase answers every name with its address and sends a phone's captive check to its page.

steps.name: the-network-back
steps.description: The device gets its network back, as it had it.

steps.name: on-its-network-again
steps.description: Once nobody is on the access point, the device retries its known network.
